ui_bugs.issue: Bidding Ops Assign specialists button not rendered. The v56 wiring (openSpecialists → BidTable Assign button → AssignSpecialistsModal) was only added to the legacy BiddingOpsPanel.jsx which is not mounted by App.js. Result: admin cannot assign per-role specialists from the UI.

rca of the issue: Root cause: /admin/e/bidding route in App.js:259 renders AdminBiddingOpsE.jsx, which was not updated as part of the v56 UI release. The v56 Assign-specialists wiring (BidTable button + AssignSpecialistsModal) was added only to the legacy BiddingOpsPanel.jsx that isn't mounted anywhere. Reproduction: login as adminsupport, click 'Bidding ops' in side nav → /admin/e/bidding → inspect any bid row → no violet Assign button, no [data-testid^='assign-specialists-'] in DOM. Mitigation: either (a) swap route to BiddingOpsPanel, or (b) import BidTable+AssignSpecialistsModal into AdminBiddingOpsE and provide specialistFor state + bidApi.assign handler mirroring BiddingOpsPanel lines 100-115.
